cli.name: AIDA CLI (human-formatted: emoji + tables)
cli.preamble:
# Tools

You are working inside an AIDA project. AIDA tracks requirements/specs and a work queue. The `aida` CLI is installed. Use it via the Bash tool for all requirement, queue, graph, status, and findings operations. Run `aida --help` or `aida <command> --help` to discover subcommands and flags. Do NOT use any MCP tools. Examples:
- `aida queue next`  / `aida queue list`
- `aida show <SPEC-ID>` / `aida graph <SPEC-ID> --blocked-by`
- `aida status` / `aida list`
- `aida findings list`
- `aida add --title "..." --type task --description "..."`

Answer the user's question, then stop.

mcp.name: AIDA MCP tools (aida mcp-serve, loaded upfront)
mcp.preamble:
# Tools

You are working inside an AIDA project. AIDA tracks requirements/specs and a work queue, exposed through a registered MCP server named `aida`. Use the AIDA MCP tools (e.g. `queue_next`, `show_requirement`, `query_graph`, `status_unified`, `list_findings`, `add_requirement`) for all requirement, queue, graph, status, and findings operations.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT use the `aida` CLI or any shell command. You must use the AIDA MCP tools exclusively.

Answer the user's question, then stop.

toon.name: AIDA token-efficient CLI / TOON mode (AIDA_AGENT_OUTPUT, TASK-964)
toon.preamble:
# Tools

You are working inside an AIDA project. AIDA tracks requirements/specs and a work queue. The `aida` CLI is installed and runs in its token-efficient AGENT output mode (TOON: a compact tabular encoding — a `name[N]{fields}:` header then one comma-joined line per row, no emoji/tables/JSON chrome; single specs render as `key: value` head fields plus a relationships table). Use `aida` via the Bash tool for all requirement, queue, graph, status, and findings operations. `aida list` defaults to a minimal id/title/status/type schema; pass `--fields a,b,c` to widen it. Run `aida <command> --help` to discover flags. Do NOT use any MCP tools. Examples:
- `aida queue list` / `aida queue next`
- `aida show <SPEC-ID>` / `aida graph <SPEC-ID> --blocked-by`
- `aida status` / `aida list` / `aida list --fields id,title,status,priority,tags`
- `aida findings list`
- `aida add --title "..." --type task --description "..."`

Answer the user's question, then stop.
